description: PERSISTENT EXPLICIT USER REJECTION. A public identity listed here must never be researched deeply, accepted, or re-proposed by daily discovery - however high its deterministic DNA score. Explicit user rejection OUTRANKS recommendation score, and the two are different concepts: a title may legitimately have a strong structural fit and still be listed here. This is an IDENTITY-LEVEL decision by the user, never a DNA adjustment, and nothing here changes any weight, guardrail, threshold or stored match_score. This file is genre-owned and is consumed by DAILY_AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md; no engine file reads it.
not_a_blacklist_for: Mixed, uncertain, lukewarm or 'concept good but looks old' reactions are NOT rejections and are deliberately absent. Those titles stay fully eligible and must earn their place by ordinary research and scoring. Negative evidence shapes the profile; it does not ban a title.
classification_rule: A calibration entry is a rejection when its baseline_evidence reaction is 'unappealing' - a flat dismissal with no stated positive interest. A reaction of 'uncertain' or 'interested' is never a rejection. Twin Peaks is the single documented exception: its reaction is 'unappealing' but the user later stated they might try it again, so it is deliberately NOT listed here.
